title: KMP String Search
description: Write a Zig program that implements the Knuth-Morris-Pratt string searching algorithm.
hints: KMP preprocesses the pattern to build a Longest Prefix Suffix (LPS) array
LPS allows the algorithm to skip unnecessary character comparisons
When a mismatch occurs, fall back using lps[j-1] instead of restarting
The pattern "ABCDABD" is found at index 13 in the text
